PR surface: Source +189, Tests +107. Total +296 across 4 files.

target.title: fix(google): import official Gemini CLI OAuth cache
target.body:
## Summary

Replaces the OpenClaw-owned Gemini CLI OAuth login path with import of credentials created by the official Gemini CLI.

This is intentionally separate from #99733 so the Gemini CLI migration can be reviewed independently from the experimental Antigravity backend.

## What changed

- Imports `oauth_creds.json` from `GEMINI_CLI_HOME/.gemini` or `~/.gemini`.
- Requires an active account in `google_accounts.json`.
- Rejects cache/account identity mismatches.
- Preserves access, refresh, expiry, id token, email, and optional project id fields.
- Re-imports the official cache through the provider refresh hook instead of using an OpenClaw-owned Google OAuth client.
- Updates provider setup copy to direct users through the official `gemini` login.

## Security boundary

OpenClaw does not launch a Google authorization flow and does not discover or embed Gemini CLI OAuth client credentials. The official Gemini CLI owns sign-in and token refresh.

Account identity validation fails closed before a profile is saved. Refresh also rejects a different active account from the one bound to the selected profile.

## Compatibility

Canonical model refs remain `google/*` with `agentRuntime.id: "google-gemini-cli"`.

The existing isolated Gemini CLI auth-home staging path remains unchanged. API-key users should continue using the `google` provider with `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY`.

Manifest and broad provider-guide copy are intentionally not changed in this draft. They can be updated after maintainers confirm the migration direction without mixing generated docs metadata into the initial review.

## Validation

Focused tests cover:

- official cache parsing
- `GEMINI_CLI_HOME` resolution
- active-account validation
- account mismatch rejection
- incomplete token rejection

Current-head GitHub CI passed.

## Tests

AI-assisted: yes.
